Home.title: Nyuppsättning
Home.mustBeLoggedIn: You need to log in to use Nyuppsättning.
Home.intro: This application supports the steering groups of Chalmersspex revivals.

Home.guideText: How a revival is run, from approval to closing.

readOnly.title: Read only
readOnly.archived: The revival is archived, so nothing in it can be changed.
readOnly.superAdmin: As super admin you can read everything here. Only the revival’s directeurs and steering group add and change rows, meetings, checklist items and guide suggestions.
readOnly.join: Add yourself to the steering group under Steering group to work in it.
readOnly.observer: As observer you can read everything here. Only the revival’s directeurs and steering group make changes.
readOnly.other: You can read this, but only the revival’s directeurs and steering group make changes.

Revival.anonymizedDescription: The participants and who did what have been removed. The guide work, the log, the checklists, the events, the budget and the materials are kept.
Revival.archiveSyncDescription: The participation has not been synced to Spexregister completely. An archived revival is anonymized after 36 months, and after that it can no longer be synced.

Validation.suggestionContentRequired: Suggest a new text or a new type.

Validation.othersPresentTooLong: Others present can be at most 1,000 characters.

Validation.itemCommentTooLong: The comment can be at most 2000 characters.

Validation.checklistNameTooLong: The name can be at most 255 characters.

Validation.memberNameTooLong: A name is at most 100 characters.
Validation.timeInvalid: Give the time as HH:MM, for example 19:00.
Validation.eventTitleRequired: Enter a title, or pick a type.
Validation.eventTitleTooLong: The title can be at most 255 characters.
Validation.eventLocationTooLong: The location can be at most 255 characters.
Validation.eventDescriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 4000 characters.
Validation.eventEndBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the first.
Validation.eventTooLong: An event can last at most 31 days after its first day.
Validation.eventEndTimeWithoutStart: Enter a start time if you enter an end time.

Validation.amountInvalid: Enter the amount in kronor, e.g. 1 200 or 1 200,50.
Validation.amountOutOfRange: The amount must be between 0.01 and 10,000,000 kr.
Validation.wholeNumberInvalid: Enter a whole number within the limits.
Validation.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity between 0.01 and 100,000, with at most two decimals.
Validation.loanRepaidBeforeReceived: The loan cannot be repaid before it was received.
Validation.budgetDescriptionTooLong: The description may be at most 255 characters.
Validation.budgetCommentTooLong: The comment may be at most 1,000 characters.
Validation.scenarioNameTooLong: The name may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.referenceLabelTooLong: The label may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.yearInvalid: Enter the year with four digits.
Validation.receiptTooLarge: The receipt may be at most 10 MB.
Validation.receiptType: The receipt must be a PDF or an image (JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP).
Validation.spexDateLabelTooLong: The text may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number in digits, e.g. 070-123 45 67.
Validation.personNameTooLong: A name may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.participantEmailRequired: A participant needs an email address to be invited.
Validation.helperContactRequired: Enter an email address or a phone number.
Validation.roleNameTooLong: The role name may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.whatsappLinkInvalid: The link must start with https://chat.whatsapp.com/.
Validation.termsTooLong: The terms may be at most 4,000 characters.
Validation.participantCommentTooLong: The comment may be at most 1,000 characters.
Validation.termsRequired: Accept the terms to answer yes.
Validation.registerConsentRequired: Choose whether Spexregister may keep your details.
Validation.referralNameTooLong: The name may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.referralCommentTooLong: The comment may be at most 1,000 characters.
Validation.taskTooLong: The task may be at most 100 characters.
Validation.slotCommentTooLong: The comment may be at most 1,000 characters.
Validation.slotEndBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
Validation.subjectTooLong: The subject may be at most 200 characters.
Validation.mailingBodyTooLong: The text may be at most 20,000 characters.
Validation.urlHttpsRequired: Enter a whole link starting with https://, without a user name or password.
Validation.inventoryQuantityInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
Validation.hostInvalid: Enter a host name such as drive.google.com.

About.title: About
About.heading: About Nyuppsättning
About.description: Nyuppsättning is provided by FGV to support the steering groups that put on a Chalmersspex again, from proposal to archiving.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, are you having trouble logging in, or are you missing access to a revival? We are happy to help you sort it out.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

publish.title: Publish the draft
publish.description: A published version can never be changed. It is numbered automatically, and revivals without a version are pinned to it.
publish.removedTitle: {count, plural, one {A chapter has been removed} other {# chapters have been removed}}
publish.removedDescription: Revivals that move to the new version lose their checklist for these chapters, with every item in it. Log rows linked to the items stay.
publish.removedConfirm: I understand that the checklists are deleted when revivals move to the new version

discard.title: Discard the draft?
discard.description: The draft and every change in it are removed. Published versions are not affected.
discard.reopens: {count, plural, one {# accepted suggestion reopens.} other {# accepted suggestions reopen.}}

Guide.refused: The guide is shown to the steering groups and directeurs of running revivals, and to FGV/JK.

editor.noChapters: The draft has no chapters. Add the first one.

editor.removeChapterType: Type the chapter's Swedish title to confirm

version.newer: There is a newer version of the guide, {label}.

suggest.description: Your suggestion goes to FGV/JK, who decide whether it goes into the next version of the guide.

tab.suggestionsDescription: The suggestions the steering group has made from this revival.

Owner.label: Owner
Owner.name: Name

Log.title: Decision log
Log.dialogDescription: Rows are never deleted. Cancel a row that no longer applies.
Log.addTag: Type a tag and press Enter
Log.emptyHint: Add the first row with New row.
Log.emptyReadOnly: Rows appear here when the steering group adds them.
Log.dateHint: When the row came into the log. Left empty, it is today.
Log.deadlineHint: When it must be done. An open row past it shows as overdue.

Meeting.title: Meetings
Meeting.dialogDescription: The agenda is the log's open rows followed by the points below.
Meeting.closeDescription: The minutes are produced and cannot be changed afterwards.
Meeting.blocked: Give every open or waiting to-do an owner before closing.
Meeting.emptyMinutes: Nothing was decided or changed in the meeting.
Meeting.emailDescription: The minutes go to the directeurs and steering group members who can log in.
Meeting.emailSent: {count, plural, one {Sent to # person} other {Sent to # people}}
Meeting.waitingLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# member waiting for access got nothing} other {# members waiting for access got nothing}}

Meeting.emailEntry: {at} by {name} to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
Meeting.logRows: The meeting's rows in the log
Meeting.emptyHint: A meeting walks through the log’s open rows. Create one with New meeting.

Checklist.title: Checklists
Checklist.itemDescription: Items are never deleted. Mark an item not applicable instead.
Checklist.notApplicableDescription: The item stays but no longer counts as open.
Checklist.waiveDescription: This is a requirement from the guide. Only a directeur can say it does not apply, and must give a reason.
Checklist.eventDescription: Changing the date recomputes deadlines, except those set by hand.
Checklist.noChapters: The revival does not follow a guide version yet, so it has no chapter checklists.
Checklist.choose: Choose a checklist, or find items across all of them.

ChecklistTemplate.title: Checklist templates
ChecklistTemplate.itemDescription: Checklists already made from the template do not change.
ChecklistTemplate.noChapters: No guide version has been published yet.
ChecklistTemplate.orphaned: Chapters no longer in the guide
ChecklistTemplate.orphanedDescription: These chapters were removed from the guide, so their templates were retired when the version was published.
ChecklistTemplate.choose: Pick a template from the list, or create one.

Catalog.deleteDescription: Nothing uses it, so it can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Catalog.kindDescription: Choose what items of this type do. It cannot be changed later.
Catalog.kindFixed: What the items do was set when the type was created and cannot be changed.

REQUIREMENT.name: Requirement
REQUIREMENT.description: Becomes a required item in the chapter's checklist for every revival.

QUESTION.name: To find out
QUESTION.description: Becomes a question in every revival's decision log.

TEXT.name: Body text
TEXT.description: Plain text, shown without a label.

Catalog.roleHelp: At most one active category per role. Scenarios use the category that has the role.

CapabilityAdmin.title: Areas of responsibility
CapabilityAdmin.description: The areas steering group members can be responsible for, which checklist templates can suggest owners by. A retired area is no longer offered, but stays with members and items that already have it. Only an area nothing uses can be deleted.

GuideItemTypeAdmin.title: Guide item types
GuideItemTypeAdmin.description: The types the guide's items can have, in the order they are offered. Each type does one of four things, set when it is created. A new name shows in every version of the guide, published ones too. A retired type is not offered for new items, but items that have it keep it.

Event.title: Events
Event.dialogDescription: The type suggests the title, length and who pays. If the type has a checklist template, the event gets a checklist.
Event.cancelDescription: The event stays as cancelled and can be restored.
Event.cancelWithChecklist: The event and its checklist stay as cancelled and can be restored.
Event.emptyHint: Add a proposed event above or create one with New event.
Event.emptyReadOnly: The revival's directeurs and steering group add events.
Event.proposalsDescription: From the guide's example timeline, counted from the premiere. Add the ones that fit.

EventType.title: Event types
EventType.intro: The events of the guide's example timeline. A type with an earliest and latest day is proposed to every revival with a premiere date, and a type with a checklist template gives its events a checklist. A retired type is no longer proposed or offered, but events that have it keep it.
EventType.dialogDescription: The texts suggest the event's content. English texts are optional.
EventType.offsetsHelp: Days from the premiere, negative before it. Leave both blank if the type should not be proposed.
EventType.offsetAround: From {before} weeks before to {after} weeks after the premiere
EventType.checklistTemplateHelp: New events of the type get a checklist from the template.
EventType.newBudgetLine: New budget line for the type
EventType.budgetLinesHelp: When a revival has an event of the type, the line is proposed for its budget, with the participants or a fixed quantity.
EventType.budgetLineRemoved: The budget line was removed from the type

Calendar.title: Subscribe in your calendar
Calendar.description: A secret link your calendar (Google, Outlook, Apple) subscribes to. It shows the revival's events and shows, and for the steering group its meetings too. Anyone with the link sees the calendar, so do not share it.
Calendar.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
Calendar.shownOnce: The link is only shown now. If you create a new one, this one stops working.
Calendar.active: You have had a calendar link since {createdAt}.
Calendar.replaceWarning: A new link replaces the old one, which stops working in calendars subscribed to it.
Calendar.none: You have no calendar link for this revival.
Calendar.revoked: The calendar link is turned off

Budget.title: Budget

readOnly.superAdmin: As a super admin you can read the budget. Only the directeur and steering group members with the finance area change it.
readOnly.observer: As an observer you can read the budget. Only the directeur and steering group members with the finance area change it.
readOnly.other: You can read the budget, but only the directeur and steering group members with the finance area change it.

Budget.unreimbursedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No expenses waiting} one {# expense waiting} other {# expenses waiting}}
Budget.categoriesHint: Open a category to see earlier revivals' figures.
Budget.noReferences: No reference figures for the category.
Budget.noCategories: The budget has no lines or transactions yet.
Budget.settingsDescription: Participants and fee are used for lines per participant and in scenarios.
Budget.loanHelp: The loan is neither income nor cost.
Budget.lineDescription: The amount is quantity times unit amount. A line may belong to an event and a decision in the log.
Budget.decisionHelp: A decision in the decision log the line is based on.
Budget.proposalsDescription: Lines the revival's events propose from their event type.
Budget.perParticipantUnset: Per participant – set the planned participants
Budget.noLinesHint: Add a line, or start from a proposal above.
Budget.noLinesReadOnly: The budget has no lines yet.
Budget.transactionDescription: An income or a cost. If someone paid a cost out of their own pocket, say who, so it shows until it is reimbursed.
Budget.paidByHelp: Who paid out of their own pocket and is to be reimbursed.
Budget.receiptHelp: PDF or image, at most 10 MB. Uploaded when the transaction is saved.
Budget.cancelDescription: The transaction stays but no longer counts and cannot be changed.
Budget.noTransactionsHint: Add income and costs as they come.
Budget.noTransactionsReadOnly: The budget has no transactions yet.
Budget.scenarioIntro: Change the values you want to try; empty fields keep the budget's value, shown in the field.
Budget.breakEvenShort: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} to break even

BudgetCategoryAdmin.title: Budget categories
BudgetCategoryAdmin.description: The categories every revival's budget uses. A category is income or cost, which cannot change. A role says what the category stands for in scenarios.

kindHelp.INCOME: Money coming in, e.g. tickets and sponsorship.
kindHelp.COST: Money going out, e.g. venues and food.

BudgetCategoryAdmin.kindChoose: Choose whether the category is income or cost. It cannot be changed later.
BudgetCategoryAdmin.kindFixed: Whether the category is income or cost was decided when it was created and cannot be changed.

ReferenceAdmin.title: Reference figures
ReferenceAdmin.description: Earlier revivals' budgets and outcomes per category. Every budget shows them beside its categories, in total and per participant. A revival that is deleted is added here automatically.
ReferenceAdmin.dialogDescription: Enter budget, actual or both for the categories there are figures for. No personal data.
ReferenceAdmin.label: Label
ReferenceAdmin.figuresHelp: Leave a category empty when the figure is missing.
ReferenceAdmin.deleteDescription: The reference and its figures are deleted for good. Budgets no longer show them.

Participation.welcomeHelper: Hi {name}! Here you answer and see everything about helping out.
Participation.responseDescription: Do you want to take part? You can change your answer later.
Participation.preferredPositionHint: What you would most like to do. The steering group decides.
Participation.commentHint: For example when you cannot make it. At most 1,000 characters.
Participation.registerConsentWhat: Spexregister is FGV's register of everyone who has taken part in Chalmersspexet. If you say yes, it records that you take part in this revival, and changes to your contact details here are saved there.
Participation.registerConsentNotFgv: It is not the same as joining FGV.

Participation.contactUnavailable: Spexregister is temporarily unavailable, so your contact details cannot be shown or changed right now.

Participation.dietaryHint: Only the directeurs and the steering group member responsible for food see this. It is deleted the day after the last show. Leave it blank to delete it now.
